ctx.x: No, they were out of George Lee's band and Booker Washington, Ed Lewis, Woody Walder and Vernon Page were all from Benny ie Moten's Molton's band. It was four of them I believe. Well, I wasn't with a big band at that time. I was working at a taxi dance parlor on 12th Street and they were flourishing up and down 12th 7th Street; there were four or five of them up along there. I can't name them all but they were there. They had The Avalon, the Beetle, and several more. This is where I came from to join Thamon Famon…
Was Baby with that band then?
